messages:
Sarah (Sales): passing ArborVista over to CS — quick context: they signed a 6mo pilot for our hosted API with a view to Dedicated if latency < 120ms and cost looks good. Exec sponsor hinted at renewal pressure in ~5 months (risk).
Jordan (CSM): thanks — important detail. who is the technical contact for SSO/network? any compliance reqs?
Sarah (Sales): primary TAC: lucy@arborvista.com. they need SAML + IP allowlist for private eval. Compliance wants logs forwarded to their SIEM (Splunk).
Anya (Onboarding PM): noted. propose provisioning window next Tue 10–12 PT. need SAML metadata and allowlist CIDRs. can we get service account + SSH jump-host info?
Mike (Support Eng): pinging on SIEM ingest — do they want syslog or HTTPS events? also flagging likely eng support for model perf if they move to Dedicated.
Sarah (Sales): they asked for HTTPS webhooks for events. I added it to the deal notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ARV-204 (deal doc) — contact is Lucy.
Jordan (CSM): creating internal onboarding epic and a dev ticket for the allowlist + SAML mapping. tickets: ONB-563 (onboarding epic), ENG-1123 (network/SAML). Jordan (CSM) assigned ONB-563 -> Anya, ENG-1123 -> Mike.
Jordan (CSM): owner summary and next steps:
- Anya: provision test tenant, schedule Tue 10–12 PT hangout with ArborVista
- Mike: implement temporary HTTPS event forwarder and validate SIEM sample payload
- Sarah: intro email to Lucy and exec sponsor (cc Jordan)
- Jordan: run kickoff, collect SAML metadata and initial prompt set for eval
Mike (Support Eng): adding checklist for quick validation:
```
1. confirm CIDRs and open 443/9411
2. ingest sample event (https JSON) to test index
3. run smoke inference calls (100 reqs) and capture p95 latency
```
Anya (Onboarding PM): noted — I'll send calendar invite and pre-hangout form for their networking team.
Sarah (Sales): one more thing — exec sponsor is Samir Patel; he's tentative about budget if the pilot doesn't show clear cost delta vs current vendor. flagging renewal risk again. :warning:
Jordan (CSM): got it. CS success metrics for pilot: p95 latency < 120ms, embedding cost delta < 25%, and 90% of sampled responses pass quality checks. I'll attach prompt/quality rubric in ONB-563.
Mike (Support Eng): please cc me on any vendor/infra emails so I can triage quickly. also request: include an example SAML AttributeStatement mapping for their IdP if possible.
Sarah (Sales): looping in Lucy now. will post the intro email thread here after sent. :slightly_smiling_face: @Jordan please add any missing owners.
Jordan (CSM): added ENG-1123 & ONB-563 links in this thread. I'll follow up with a quick pre-hangout checklist 24h before. thanks team. :party_parrot:
DeployBot: created ONB-563 and ENG-1123 (links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-563, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-1123)
Sarah (Sales): intro email sent to lucy@arborvista.com and samir@arborvista.com — copied Jordan + Anya + Mike. I'll paste the client replies into this thread for context.
Jordan (CSM): great — marking initial risk level as Moderate. will update if sponsor signals change.
